name: Baker's yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae)
short_description: Single-celled ovoid fungus (~5-10 um) that multiplies by budding and leaves chitin bud scars on its mother cell. Its fermentation turns sugar into carbon dioxide and ethanol - the gas that raises bread dough and the alcohol in beer and wine - and it is one of biology's most important model organisms, the first eukaryote to have its genome fully sequenced.

textbook.1: PASS - muted, sophisticated educational palette with thin clean outlines exactly in the rod-bacterium/parasite house style; ovoid mother with ONE smaller daughter bud at a constricted neck, three raised pale bud scars on the wall, quarter cut-away showing the layered ochre wall, teal plasma-membrane line, blue-violet nucleus with nucleolus, pale green vacuole, three red-brown mitochondria and teal-stippled ER/ribosomes; no hyphae, no bacterial features, no text, dark charcoal background filling the frame edge-to-edge. Chosen as label base.

sem.1: PASS - photorealistic false-colour amber SEM of a SINGLE ovoid yeast cell with a smaller daughter bud at a constricted neck and three sharply raised circular bud scars standing proud of the granular surface, matching the real micrograph closely; surface only, no internal structures (correct for SEM), shallow depth of field with softly blurred neighbouring cells, no text, no border.

3d.1: PASS - natural biological tints: warm translucent cream-amber cell body, dusty-ochre wall with three raised bud scars, teal plasma membrane, blue-violet nucleus with darker nucleolus, large pale grey-green vacuole, red-brown mitochondria, fine teal ribosome speckles on ER sheets; bud at a constricted neck; soft studio lighting on a clean dark background, not neon and not near-monochrome, no text.

watercolor.1: PARTIAL - aged paper does fill the frame edge-to-edge (no sheet-on-surface) and the morphology is right, but the plate is nearly monochrome sepia with a heavy grey wash blot behind the cell; the house style (cocci/rod-bacterium) needs distinct translucent colour per structure. Fix-prompt: give each structure its own gentle transparent tint (ochre wall, teal membrane, blue-violet nucleus, sage vacuole, rose mitochondria) and replace the dark halo with a light barely-there wash.
watercolor.2: PASS - clearly coloured naturalist plate on warm aged paper that fills the whole frame corner-to-corner with only a soft pale wash halo; violet nucleus with nucleolus, sage-green vacuole, rose-brown mitochondria, teal membrane line and ochre layered wall; one smaller bud at a constricted neck plus two bud scars; fine ink linework, no text, no mat/frame/sheet.

reference: PASS - Wikimedia Commons SEM (Mogana Das Murtey & Patchamuthu Ramasamy, CC BY 3.0) genuinely shows Saccharomyces cerevisiae: a field of ovoid yeast cells with small daughter buds at constricted necks and the diagnostic raised circular chitin bud scars. Original carried a white scale bar and was a dense group, so it was cleaned with edit_image.py (real-02) to isolate ONE cell with its bud and bud scars, remove the scale bar and apply a natural amber false-colour - shapes and surface texture unchanged.
decision: muted refined cutaway; bud, bud neck, bud scars and all core organelles labelled; the clearest plate for teaching the budding-yeast archetype
